Root.semantic: inherits the Menu.Root surface MINUS handle/triggerId/defaultTriggerId/modal/openOnHover/delay/closeDelay and children; adds its own onOpenChange and a ReactNode children.

Root.closeParentOnEsc.semantic: @deprecated — has no effect on Context Menu (kept for API compatibility).

Trigger.semantic: area that opens the menu on right click or long press; state {open}; no props beyond BaseUIComponentProps.

Positioner.anchor.semantic: root context menus are anchored at the pointer by default.

Positioner.side / align.semantic: note align defaults to 'start' here, unlike Menu ('center').

Positioner.sideOffset / alignOffset.default: root: -5 and 2 when `side` is not specified and `align` is not 'center'; otherwise 0
Positioner.sideOffset / alignOffset.semantic: keeps the popup near the pointer without covering it; submenus use the Menu defaults.

Positioner.positionMethod.semantic: @deprecated — has no effect on Context Menu.

Item / CheckboxItem / RadioItem / LinkIt.semantic: all Menu semantics apply (typeahead via `label`, radio/checkbox groups, links).

dataAttributes: Positioner: data-open, data-closed, data-anchor-hidden, data-side, data-align (+ ContextMenuPositionerCssVars)

Popup / Backdrop / Arrow / Item / CheckboxItem(+Indicator) / RadioItemIndicator / LinkItem / SubmenuTrigger: same attribute sets as Menu (data-highlighted, data-disabled, data-checked, data-unchecked, data-starting-style, data-ending-style, data-open, data-closed, data-side, data-align, data-instant, data-uncentered)
Root / Group / GroupLabel / Separator / RadioGroup: none
renderProp: Same shared `render` contract as Menu (every part accepts ReactElement | (props, state) => ReactElement, plus state-driven className/style); Menu.createHandle()/Menu.Handle are NOT exported from the ContextMenu namespace (no detached triggers). useRender for custom components; mergeProps/mergePropsN for merging.
controlled: `open` / `defaultOpen` + `onOpenChange(open, eventDetails)`; `onOpenChangeComplete(open)`; imperative `actionsRef` -> { unmount, close }. Radio/checkbox item state uses the same controlled pairs as Menu (RadioGroup value/defaultValue/onValueChange; CheckboxItem checked/defaultChecked/onCheckedChange). No modal prop — context menus cannot be made modal.
keyboard: Identical to Menu because it shares the Menu implementation: ArrowUp/ArrowDown (or Left/Right when orientation='horizontal') roving highlight, Home/End, typeahead against item text or `label` (500 ms reset), Enter/Space activate, Escape dismisses, submenu open/close with arrow keys and Shift+Tab closes the submenu. Opening is pointer-driven: right click / long press on ContextMenu.Trigger (docs advise always providing a visible alternative control). No PageUp/PageDown.
notableDifferences: Root is a strict subset of Menu.Root: no `handle`, no `triggerId`/`defaultTriggerId`, no `modal`, no hover-open props, and `closeParentOnEsc`/`positionMethod` exist only as deprecated no-ops — a migration that passed those props will silently lose behaviour.
Positioner defaults differ from Menu: `align='start'`, pointer anchoring, sideOffset -5 / alignOffset 2 (root, when side unspecified and align != center), arrowPadding 0 for roots.

Trigger renders a plain <div> area (no button semantics) and only emits data-popup-open/data-pressed; React Aria's context menu trigger is a styled element with the same constraint, but Base UI has no `isDisabled` on the trigger and no data-disabled attribute on Trigger in 1.8.0.
No Menu.Viewport and no Handle exports; everything else (items, groups, submenus, radio/checkbox) is literally the Menu part implementations, so data-* attributes and keyboard behaviour are shared.
Only opens via right click / long press (docs recommend it be an enhancement, never the only path to an action).
